business_overview.one_sentence: Cocoon Holdings is a Chapter 21 investment company whose principal activities are investment holding and investing in listed and unlisted securities.

segments.name: Investment holding and securities investment
segments.description: The group mainly invests in securities listed on recognised stock exchanges and unlisted investments with profit growth and capital appreciation potential.

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is dividend income from listed equity securities classified as financial assets at FVTPL; trading securities disposal gains and fair value changes are reported in other gains/losses.
business_notes: Trading of trading securities is also disclosed as a principal activity.
The annual report states the group is an investment holding company and the directors consider segment information unnecessary.

non_recurring_items.item: Net realised gains on disposal of equity securities classified as financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Realised securities investment gain, not a recurring operating profit stream after deducting investment principal.

non_recurring_items.item: Net unrealised fair value losses on equity securities classified as financial assets at FVTPL
Gain on modification and waiver of interest of promissory notes
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Debt modification/waiver gains, not recurring investment operating cash profit.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, note 10 and note 24, pages 102 and 117-119

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank balances bearing prevailing market interest rates.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position and note 22, pages 67 and 116

funds_assets.business_substance: Deposits placed with securities brokers for trading listed investments, unsecured, 0%-0.01% interest, repayable on demand.

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed in Hong Kong
investment_assets.business_substance: Listed Hong Kong equity securities held for investment/trading.

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed in the U.S.
investment_assets.business_substance: U.S. listed and OTC equity securities held for investment/trading; several holdings use less observable valuation inputs.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 19, pages 108-113 and fair value disclosure page 132

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - unlisted equity investments
investment_assets.business_substance: Unlisted equity investments in LNPR and Chelsea Tech.

investment_assets.item: Financial asset at FVTOCI - unlisted equity investment
investment_assets.business_substance: 20% interest in Perfect Path, an Anguilla private entity engaged in gold mining; no control or significant influence.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: One outstanding promissory note due to an independent third party, repayable on or before 31 December 2026; another HK$10 million note was settled in 2025.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position and note 24, pages 67 and 116-119

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Other payables, including HK$611,000 investment management fee payable to Tiger Securities, a related-party manager.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Cash flow is dominated by securities purchases/sales and broker balances. Because securities investment is the principal activity, investment gains cannot be treated as a separate operating cash-profit stream after deducting the portfolio principal.

gaps: The 2023 annual report was not extracted in this run, so the profit median uses only 2024-2025 annual report facts and is treated as insufficient for a normal operating-profit denominator.
The report does not split cash by listed parent versus subsidiaries, but available funds are described as mainly bank and licensed securities firm balances denominated mainly in HKD.
The fair value realisability of OTC and unlisted investments cannot be proven from the annual report alone; liquidation haircuts are therefore conservative.
